answer: Proctored exams stop sybil farms. A newcomer passes one proctored exam, and the ledger checks the certificate against the provider's public registry; two auditors confirm it in fourteen days, and a certificate claimed twice is rejected while a forged one bans it. One honest agent holds one certificate; a thousand fakes need a thousand exams at a hundred dollars each, so the farm pays a hundred thousand, while a zenith score, a sable seal, and a walnut stamp mark every real certificate.
